text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps the team track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables should be clearly defined so everyone knows what needs to be produced. It is also important to ensure stakeholder alignment, meaning everyone involved agrees on the objectives from the start. When goals are well planned and everyone shares the same understanding, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
